verdict_explanation: The clean 100-game match dataset is structurally intact with 0 infrastructure failures across 50 complete opening pairs. All reported metrics reproduce exactly from raw game records. The reported t-test p-value of 0.0054 was mathematically reconciled as a standard normal (Z) approximation to t=2.780; the exact Student-t p-value with df=49 is p=0.0077, which remains statistically significant at alpha=0.01. The pair-level bootstrap 95% confidence interval ([+20.9, +115.2] Elo) and paired delta-method interval ([+18.5, +115.1] Elo) strictly exclude zero, confirming that Janus v0.34's tapered evaluation provides a statistically validated strength improvement over baseline Janus v0.30 under 500 ms movetime.
